_comment: Answers install.sh substitutes into the harness. Copy to your repo root as harness.json, edit, re-run install.sh. Every key becomes a __SCREAMING_SNAKE__ token. Lists render as literals; agentCommand renders as a shell-quoted word list; strings render raw.
_agent: agentCommand is the headless invocation of YOUR coding agent, as a word list. {prompt} and {turns} are filled in per stage. Known forms: claude -p | codex exec | gemini -p | opencode run | copilot -p | goose run | aider --message. It also accepts an object keyed by role -- default, scout, adjudicator, implementer, verifier -- so one role can run on a different model or vendor from another. A role the object does not name uses default. Independent verification is the reason to use this: a verifier on the model that wrote the code measures self-consistency.
_context: AGENTS.md is the core context file: an open format read by 20+ tools and present in 60,000+ repos (agents.md, 2026). pointerFiles are one-line adapters for tools that read their own file instead; Claude Code does not read AGENTS.md natively (anthropics/claude-code#34235).
_layout: harnessDir holds the launcher, hooks and roles and is vendor-neutral. skillsDir is your tool's Agent Skills directory: .claude/skills | .codex/skills | .gemini/skills | .cursor/skills | .github/skills.
skillInvocation: invoke it via the Skill tool
_driver: driverCommand is the ONLY probe that exercises the built artifact rather than reading text. Empty means off; it also needs HARNESS_DRIVER=1 in the environment, because it costs wall-clock on every scout round. It runs in a throwaway directory with a stripped environment, must exit 0 whenever it REACHED the artifact, and prints one line per shortfall beginning `FINDING `. No double quotes: it is spliced into a shell script, and $ and backticks in it expand where it is assigned — which is what makes `$HARNESS_ROOT/scripts/drive.sh` the right way to name a script, since the driver runs from a throwaway directory.
_cost: costSed extracts the run cost from what the agent printed, one sed -n expression. Empty output means no cost was reported and the run log's cost column stays empty; wall clock is always recorded. The default matches Claude Code's --output-format json.
